label: ATV Set: Enduro 250, Trike 200, Utility Quad 4x4
generated: generated by AtvIso.gameplayAll() off SPECS — the same table the bake reads. Regenerate from ATV Pack Iso.dc.html; never edit a number here.

frame.origin: ground-centre of the wheelbase (z=0 is the road)
frame.at_rest: every value is at steer 0, susF/susR 0, lean 0, yaw 0. The dirtbike's at-rest is stand 1 (parked): see its STAND.world_at_rest for the leaned points.

pivot_px._note: one cell for all three bodies; model z=0 projects to the pivot row in all 8 facings at every pose

facings._note: dir 0 (N) shows the TAIL: the machine points away. dir 4 (S) shows the nose. Street side (-x) reads at NE E SE; curb side (+x) at SW W NW.

collider_bbox._note: width is over the GRIPS (0.86); the body itself is 0.38 wide at the shrouds. Baked parked she leans 12deg to the street side and the collider should too — see STAND.world_at_rest.

mass_kg_estimate.basis: NOT measured off the rig — no rig geometry carries mass. A gameplay knob, quoted so a load model has a number to start from.

BODY.provenance: SPECS.dirtbike + BODIES (loa = yMax - yMin, wheelbase = axF - axR)

SADDLE._what: THE BAKE CARRIES NO RIDER. These are the mount points the character rig sits on. Posture is ASTRIDE — legs either side of the machine, hands on the grips, feet on the pegs.

seat._note: one 0.82 m cushion. A pillion is possible in the rig (nothing divides it) and unruled in the game.

grips._note: anchors() applies the steer transform — read grips from there, not from these rest values, when the bars are turned.

pegs._note: a 0.10 m peg each side; nothing to stand on beside them.

SADDLE.rider_frame: every point above rides the suspension (dz(y)) and, on the bike, the lean. anchors(dir,opts) returns them posed; the character rig should take leanDeg from dims() and roll the rider with the machine.

mount._note: the stand is on the street side (-x); a rider mounts over it and kicks it up. Curb-side mounting is possible and not the habit.

SADDLE.provenance: SPECS.dirtbike seatRef / grips / pegs — exact; reach points are width/2 + 0.55 m outboard at the seat ref y

STEERING.type: handlebar; the WHOLE front assembly (wheel, fork, fender, lamp, bars) turns about the raked steering head

axis._note: a real raked axis — the front wheel's contact point moves with steer, which is why the bars swing over the tank a little

turning._note: geometric, at full lock, no lean and no slip — a real bike turns tighter by leaning, which is LEAN's job

SUSPENSION.rule: the BODY moves, the wheels stay on the ground: dz(y) = -(susF*TF)*t - (susR*TR)*(1-t), t = (y - axR)/(axF - axR), applied to every sprung polygon and to every SADDLE point
SUSPENSION._note: fork travel on the real class is 2-3x this; the rig keeps what reads at 32 px/m.

roll._note: the front wheel is a different radius and turns rR/rF times as fast; the rig scales it so both tread the same road.

WHEELS.tread: knobby — the lug pitch is fitted to a whole number of lugs per revolution, so the roll loop closes exactly

world_at_rest._note: at stand 1 the tip sits on z=0 to 1 mm; the machine is rotated about its contact line so the tires still touch at x=0

STAND.rule: she BAKES PARKED. A dirtbike does not stand upright without a rider: the roll/turn/bounce cues set stand 0, and a game that shows her upright with nobody aboard is showing a bug the rig will not catch.
STAND.cue: park — 8 frames, stand 0 -> 1, run reversed to kick it up before riding off
STAND.provenance: SPECS.dirtbike.stand* — exact; world tip = lean(standTip) at 12deg

LEAN.axis: the tyre contact line — world y-axis at x=0, z=0 — so the contact patch never leaves the ground
LEAN.cornering: lean INTO the turn: steer +1 (left) pairs with lean -1 (street side). The turn cue couples lean = -0.55 * steer and yaw = 14 * steer; the rig does not enforce the coupling.
LEAN.stacks_with: stand — total = lean*28 - stand*12 degrees; dims().leanDeg publishes the sum
LEAN.rider: the rider leans WITH the machine — anchors() already applies it to the saddle points

CARGO._no_rack: nothing on a dirtbike carries cargo. The pillion half of the seat is the only place a second thing goes, and that is a rider.

headlamps.alt: lamp:false swaps it for a white MX number plate at the same station — no light at night

ATTACH.night: headlamps swap to the glow ramp and spill one pixel onto their neighbours; the tail lamps do not glow

INTERACT._note: mount from the street side over the stand, then stand 1 -> 0
a rider does this as part of mounting; published separately so a game can leave her on the stand while someone sits

YAW.what: heading between the eight facings. A RENDER param: the model turns about z under the fixed key before projection, so the shading is rebaked, not rotated.
YAW.frame: every metre in this file is in the machine frame and does not move with yaw
YAW.pivot: unaffected; the origin projects to the published pivot at any yaw

_excluded.THRESHOLD: no doors, no sill, no step. The way in is a leg over the saddle — SADDLE.mount carries the reach points.
_excluded.cab_roof_bed: none. Nothing on these three is sat inside or stood on except the pegs.
_excluded.levers_pedals: clutch and brake levers, shifter and brake pedal are 1-2 px at this scale and left out. The bars carry grips only.
_excluded.mirrors_plate_decals: none. A number plate is the MX plate on the bike (lamp:false), not a registration.
_excluded.float: these do not swim. No FLOAT section; the Otter is the amphibian.
_excluded.rider: not in the bake, by design — see SADDLE.
_excluded.chain: the sprocket is modelled, the chain is not — at 32 px/m it is a one-pixel line the swingarm already draws.
_excluded.kickstart: not modelled; the stand is the only lever on her.

_confirm.reach_points: ground-level spots derived from the seat ref, width/2 + 0.55 m outboard; NOT tested against terrain, a wall or another vehicle.
_confirm.two_up: every seat here is one undivided cushion. How many ride is a gameplay call the rig cannot make.
_confirm.ramp_budget: 11 ramps at most on any build of any body — the fleet cap is 16.
_confirm.parked_state: the bake default is stand 1 (parked, leaning). A game that pools sprites should bake the ridden state from the roll cue, not from the default.

collider_bbox._note: width is over the one-piece rear fender (1.20); the balloon tires stop at 1.12.

mass_kg_estimate.basis: NOT measured off the rig — no rig geometry carries mass. A gameplay knob, quoted so a load model has a number to start from.
